trigger: a foe condition's one-line explanation on the long-press foe card and the chip tap: src/browser/foeConditions.js#FOE_CONDITION_DESC
before: Seeing stars. It loses its next turn, and your melee blows, and your Joiners', hit it automatically until then. Then it remembers where it is.
after: Seeing stars. It loses its next turn, and your melee blows, and your Joiners' and summoned allies', hit it automatically until then. Then it remembers where it is.
why: Phase 92.3 plan 02 (user ruling 2026-10-02, "fix summons so they auto hit like others"): a summoned ally's strike (and the legacy sheet-less ally's) at a helpless foe now hits automatically too, so the line that says who hits it automatically adds your summoned allies to your melee blows and your Joiners'.
